metadata.scenario: A user calls to resolve a billing discrepancy where they were charged twice for a subscription. Category: Billing. Flags: billing_dispute.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret. How can I assist you today? Hi Margaret, my name is Karen Lewis. I was referred by my husband's cardiac surgeon's office. Nice to meet you, Karen! How can I help you regarding your husband? Well, I actually have a billing issue. We were charged twice for his subscription. I'm sorry to hear that. Let me help you resolve this. Can I get your account information? Yes, my husband's name is John Lewis, and the account number is 123456. Thank you, Karen. Just a moment while I pull up the account. Okay, I see the charges here. It looks like there were two transactions for the same service. I apologize for the mistake. I appreciate that, but I need to know how quickly this can be resolved. Definitely. I can initiate a refund right away. It typically takes 3-5 business days to process. That sounds good, but I also need confirmation once it's processed. Absolutely, I’ll send you an email confirmation. What email address should I use? Please use karenlewis@email.com. Got it, Karen. I’ll send you the confirmation as soon as it’s processed. Thank you. Also, can you tell me more about the post-operative care services you offer? Sure! We provide skilled nursing care and post-surgery recovery care. How much does the post-surgery recovery care cost? It's priced between $85 and $110 for 1-3 hours of specialized care. That sounds reasonable. Can you schedule that for me after his surgery next month? Yes, I can connect you with our Care Coordinator to set that up. That would be great, thank you. Please hold while I transfer you to Lisa Chen, our Care Coordinator. Okay, thank you again for your help. You're welcome, Karen! One moment please. Lisa, I have Karen Lewis on the line, interested in post-operative care for her husband. Karen, you’re now connected with Lisa. Hi, Lisa! I’m looking to schedule post-operative care for my husband. Hi, Karen! I can help with that. Let’s get the details started.
